name: yupiter
description: Standard-library-style utilities for Node.js — printf-style I/O with zero runtime dependencies. ESM + CJS, Node.js 9+.
author: Uoc Azizah

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/postbuild.cjs --dist
scripts.build:test: tsc -p tsconfig.test-cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test-esm.json && node scripts/postbuild.cjs --tests
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.cjs && node scripts/check-exports.cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck
